canonical_serialization: utf8 sorted-key JSON with identical decision field order and no NaN
identity_value_scan: reject exact side identifiers and imported run-identity values in package keys or strings
mapping_visibility: private ignored batch only; never included in the judge-visible package
position_balance: within every batch and for every hidden side, max(position count) - min(position count) <= 1
randomization: private seed and SHA-256 labels deterministically rank samples and Latin-square base, direction and block order without language-runtime RNG dependence
seed_visibility: private ignored batch only; never printed or tracked
